about: Labeled retrieval-quality eval set for search_knowledge (/search). Each case is a natural-language query a user/agent might ask, paired with the KB note(s) that SHOULD be retrieved. Relevance is keyed on the note TITLE (the stable '[ingest] <title>' produced by bench/ingest/inject.js from source content) rather than the volatile note:note-<id>, so the set survives re-ingestion. The scorer (scripts/retrieval-bench.js) resolves titles -> live keys at run time and matches case-insensitively, ignoring the '[ingest] ' prefix. Corpus = the kept doc-notes (33) + kept git-notes (9) + structure nodes injected by inject.js.

cases.query: how do I reference a task from another session
relevant_titles: Cross-session task IDs must be namespaced session/id
cases.note: single precise anchor (the v5-grounded anchor note)

cases.query: is it safe to write the native task json file directly
relevant_titles: Read native task files; never write them

cases.query: the native task file format keeps changing across versions, how is that handled
relevant_titles: Native task format is undocumented — isolate it behind one adapter

cases.query: should the orchestrator reimplement its own task scheduler
relevant_titles: Build on native tasks, never reimplement orchestration

cases.query: what happens when a winner merge hits a git conflict
relevant_titles: merge_attempt auto-aborts on conflict, never forces

cases.query: which git repo do branch and merge operations run against
relevant_titles: Git ops resolve target repo separately from the daemon workspace

cases.query: code changes are built in isolation and not merged automatically
relevant_titles: Autonomous loop holds every code change; merge is a human decision
feat(loop): hold-merge mode — autonomous loop builds in isolation, never merges
cases.note: two notes (a doc-note + the git commit that introduced it) both cover hold-merge

cases.query: local https certificate fails to be trusted by the browser
relevant_titles: Self-signed certs cannot shortcut local HTTPS; mkcert is required

cases.query: why does the desktop app not run my settings.json hooks
relevant_titles: Desktop app runs MCP but not settings.json hooks

cases.query: the PreToolUse gate blocks my edit even though the task status is wrong
relevant_titles: The PreToolUse gate enforces task existence, not status truth

cases.query: how should I authenticate requests to the daemon
relevant_titles: Bearer-token auth is opt-in, default-deny allowlist when set

cases.query: the benchmark shows 65% less work which seems wrong, how to measure tokens
relevant_titles: Measure work by output_tokens, not gross-minus-plumbing

cases.query: why is the ON vs OFF context cost difference just cache reads
relevant_titles: Context cost is entirely payload size; lean payload → cost parity

cases.query: do not work inline, route multi-step work through the orchestrator
relevant_titles: Route substantive multi-step work through the orchestrator, not inline

cases.query: a new task ended up as a disconnected orphan root node
relevant_titles: New tasks must be wired in, never left as orphan roots

cases.query: when should I record a decision as a note node
relevant_titles: Capture durable decisions as note nodes; lean toward NOT recording

cases.query: how do dependent tasks pass context cheaply without re-reading everything
relevant_titles: Two-tier context handoff between dependent tasks

cases.query: two tasks write the same file, can I run them in parallel
relevant_titles: Serialize file-coupled tasks; the graph tracks logical deps only

cases.query: what decides whether the optimization loop iterates again or stops
relevant_titles: Converged-vs-iterate is decided mechanically in the daemon

cases.query: the loop produced no usable winner for several rounds, what then
relevant_titles: A stuck optimization escalates to a human, never self-drops

cases.query: the planner cancelled a running task and caused a runaway
relevant_titles: Planner only ADDs nodes; never touches in-flight work

cases.query: check whether an approach was already tried and rejected before proposing it
relevant_titles: Check the rejected-approaches ledger before proposing

cases.query: the judge should never write or edit the candidate attempts
relevant_titles: Judge evaluates only; never generates or edits attempts

cases.query: how does the judge decide when there is a metric spec versus only rationale
relevant_titles: Judge metric-first when a spec is present, else rationale

cases.query: never make up a benchmark number for the judge
relevant_titles: Never fabricate a benchmark; degrade to baseline-only

cases.query: cross workspace dependency where the provider lives in another workspace
relevant_titles: Ghost edges store on the consumer; resolve foreign status on demand

cases.query: the setup wizard must not run password steps silently
relevant_titles: Setup is an idempotent doctor; never run password steps silently

cases.query: how does the agent know to spawn idle stop or plan each tick
relevant_titles: The daemon decides each tick; the agent only executes and reschedules
